title: At the movies and at a ballroom event.....
content: Several days ago I dreamed I was in the parking lot of the mall with a friend of mine. In real life, this friend passed away 9 years ago. But in the dream, he was exactly like he was in real life. He was pissing me off. See we had bought tickets to see a movie and all he kept doing was complain that he had to skip work for this. That he probably would get fired. I remember to one side of the parking lot there was also what looked like a home depot or a Lowes. There was basically a lumber yard. We went inside the mall and we were just outside the theater lobby. There were some table set up outside and decided to wait until it was time for the movie to start. My friend kept complaining and wanted to go home. At this point two other friends showed up. They were school friend who I haven't seen in ages. They came and sat down with us and started to joke around. Just a bunch of guys hanging out. I started to look around and notice more people I recognized from when I was younger walking all around this area. Some were going in and out of the theater, while others were making their way to the back of the mall. Our two friends then asked if we were there for something called "The Golden Ballroom" event. Everyone was supposedly there. I have had other dreams about being in a golden ballroom but I never thought of it connected to the mall in some form or another. This ballroom is always where I try to hook up with a woman I knew from work. They're the kind of dream where you're trying to get to someone but they're always at a distance. Or you've just missed them. Our friends said that we should go and check it out. I was dressed for the occasion, but my friend wasn't. he was wearing some dirty old pants and a green scooby doo t-shirt. But then I said I was going to see a movie. Again my friend kept saying he just wanted to go home. That's when this woman showed up. It was someone we used to know from school. She was dressed in a golden gown and her boobs almost popping out. She started to talk to us, and then invited us to go with her to the ballroom. I again decided to go to the movies. But my friend decided to go with her. Sure he wanted to go home at first, but now he was ready to follow this woman anywhere. I was now inside the theater, sitting up in the balcony. the movie seemed to be about halfway through. Don't know why, because I wouldn't bother with such a thing, it was a Family Guy movie. I got a phone call and answered it. I was told that my friend was outside by the lumber yard and that I should go and see how he was. So I went outside. I don't remember much about this part, except I convinced him to go see the remainder of the movie. He then told me that he felt weird at the ballroom and that's why he left. But then I wanted to go. So I went by myself. As I walked through the mall I noticed it was all decked out for Christmas. But as I got closer to the ballroom, everything appeared golden. Gold everywhere. I went inside and was greeted by people I hadn't seen in ages. There was a huge banner that read 'Golden Ballroom'. That's when I felt weird. Like I shouldn't be there. The woman I had talked to earlier came up to me and introduced me to another woman. I recognized her too. It was this woman's best friend. Not using any names. While they might have wanted me there, everyone else kept giving me bad vibes. I even heard some say that I shouldn't be there. So I decided to leave. Everyone was surrounding me. But I managed to get to the doors which ended up being locked. I remember the two women were calling me to go back. But everyone else seemed to be trying to push me out. Next thing I knew I was already running towards my friend who was waiting out in the parking lot. I don't even remember if we drove off. Any way, I know that people have talked about the theater a lot. But has anyone come across a ballroom that is just completely covered in gold. The lights are golden. Everyone inside seems to have something on that is golden as well. the entrance is all gold. Has anyone seen a place like this?
